expected.finding: **[P1]** Credential redaction leaks short-option passwords and quoted values. In [improvement_policy.py:108](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/improvement_policy.py:108), the flag regex omits `-p` and stops at whitespace inside quotes. A synthetic trace retained `-pFAKE_PASSWORD_123` unchanged and turned `--password [REDACTED]` into `--password [REDACTED]`. These excerpts can reach workflow logs and mined policy evidence. Handle short credential options and redact entire quoted values before exporting trace text.

**[P2]** Rollback history compares coverage from different datasets. In [revise-improvement-policy.py:724](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:724), `coverage_before` uses the current policy’s own rounds, while `coverage_after` uses the entire archive. A reproduction recorded **0.50 → 0.33**, although the restored policy scored **1.00** on those same rounds. This makes history and dashboard regression statistics misleading. Record both figures over the same rounds and label any whole-archive figures separately.
